changed_family: audit-complete history, typed enumeration and immutable review isolation for the already-frozen swing, structure and BOS semantics

swing.inheritance: unchanged from the SHA-bound parent protocol
swing.audit_enumeration: every raw-recoverable FORMING, CONFIRMED, BROKEN and FORMATION_FAILED typed swing is enumerated with pivot, observed, confirmation, break, lifecycle and failure-reason fields

bos_audit_amendments.attempt_history: retain every admitted real-completed wick-attempt clock in strict chronological order; attempt_count equals the length and last_attempt_at equals the final element
bos_audit_amendments.confirmed_resolution_order: every retained wick-attempt clock is strictly before a CONFIRMED resolved_at clock
bos_audit_amendments.failed_resolution_order: a FAILED state may have its final wick-attempt at resolved_at only for failure_reason superseded or opposite_structure_break
bos_audit_amendments.boundary_terminal_publication: every pending BOS is emitted once as a typed FAILED state in the boundary-clock FrameObservation before tracker state is cleared; event memory is supplementary rather than a substitute
bos_audit_amendments.simultaneous_gap_and_contract_change: publish one terminal state per pending BOS with contract_change_reset as the deterministic reason, retain both reader anomaly codes, and increment reset_epoch once
bos_audit_amendments.post_boundary_visibility: typed boundary terminal states are visible only at the boundary decision clock; their immutable event details remain in bounded causal event memory afterward

blind_review_amendments.eligibility: Pass1 may select a case only when all four causal histories are non-empty, contract-consistent and contain the focal swing, pending clock, every attempt clock and resolved clock needed for exact Pass2 materialization
blind_review_amendments.pass2_identity: Pass2 reclassifies the reproduced BOS and exactly matches semantic_event_id, bos_id, timeframe, direction, case_class, target_swing_id, source_structure_id and semantic_state_hash
blind_review_amendments.enumeration: authority and reviewer each enumerate every raw-recoverable typed swing and BOS candidate at the case clock; a recoverable current swing remains present when its prior_same_side object was evicted, and missing prior/nonrecoverable context is explicitly counted; reviewer-visible artifacts contain no semantic_event_id or hidden focal judgment
blind_review_amendments.visual_coverage: truth uses bounded fixed-width price panels plus a complete categorical retained-index map for every typed swing and BOS marker; price panels may never expand beyond their registered bar limits
blind_review_amendments.selection_authority: selection and Pass2 bind their original absolute engine root; an engine-only random identity mapping links reviewer units to exact case commitments, reviewer directories are physically created only in random reviewer-identity order, and the reviewer export exposes neither event identities nor case-completion hashes
blind_review_amendments.review_revalidation: every actual review document is schema-, identity-, attestation-, index-, issue-code- and action-language-validated again before truth
blind_review_amendments.path_isolation: reviewer export, reviews, global lock, truth and scorecard destinations are disjoint from the physically bound selection/Pass2 engine output root and every immutable packet or reviewer tree; public review locking verifies this before any write

unchanged_attestation: No swing relation, structure lifecycle, BOS confirmation threshold, playbook, decision, risk, execution, future-path or economic rule is changed by R3.
